waitForCacheUpdate.description:
If set to true, the function will ensure that all directory usage timestamps
(stored in `dirUsagesUpdatedTime`) are more recent than the function's invocation time.
This guarantees that the cache has been fully refreshed at least once before returning a result.

waitSpec.description:
If set and waitForCacheUpdate is set to be true, this will specify the retry's waitSpec used for waiting
the cache refreshing.
